stance_rationale: PD30 contains useful Method A reconstruction evidence, but it is not decision-grade Forge evidence because RF-F2, RF-F3, RF-F4, RF-F5, RF-F6, and RF-F7 remain unresolved. The weakest pattern is converting failed same-baseline and turnover evidence into a structural-layer explanation instead of producing same-period, same-cost, same-DSR, round-trip-compliant validation.

critical_concerns.description: PD30 reports TO 3.33x and Hurdle PASS, but run_all_pd30.R annualizes one-way turnover only; applying RF-F7 round-trip x2 gives 6.66x, above the 600% hard hurdle.

The S4 v2 comparator is a documented overlay strategy over a different 255m window, while PD30 is a 296m raw-alpha foundation; same-period, same-cost, same-DSR baseline evidence is absent, so the 0/4 failure cannot be rationalized as merely apples-to-oranges.

PD30 contains only CAPM Harvey evidence, not CAPM/C3/C4/FF5/FF6; DSR uses M=10 while alpha 5 + optimizer 5 + forge 3 implies at least 13 trials, baseline DSR parity is absent, and harvey_capm_alpha_dsr.csv conflicts with dsr_bailey_ldp_m10.csv.
The equity chart code marks 2008 and 2020 crises, not the 2024-01-23 lockbox boundary; no frozen buy-and-hold extension or Pre-LB/Lockbox/Combined decomposition is provided.

The requested mailbox weights.csv is absent and monthly_returns.parquet is absent; the stage fallback weights.csv is a stale 155-date static sleeve schedule, not the PD30 298-date ticker-level C_softmax/EW/linear schedule.
PD30 hashes alpha_pd27, alpha_pd24, ETF, and alpha_package_pd27, but it does not provide the role-required start/end md5 evidence for risk_package and optimization_package.
PD30 marks AX-002 PIT as PASS, but alpha_package_pd27 still reports C13/C14/C15 as PARTIAL due to direction alignment, missing Usable_Date, and direct parquet routing limitations.

supporting_arguments: Pure hashes reported for alpha_pd27, alpha_pd24, ETF, and alpha_package_pd27 do match their local md5 values.
stage_artifacts/WT_D20260511_001/alpha_scores.parquet is a real time-series panel: 62,916 rows, 184 sig_dates, 2011-01-01 to 2026-04-01.
covariance.parquet in stage_artifacts/WT_D20260511_001 is PSD with min eigenvalue 0.01217143 and condition number 8.812171.
PD30 C_softmax holdings.csv has 5,960 rows = 298 dates x 20 names, max weight 0.20, and no per-date sum violations.
unresolved_disputes: Whether PD30 can be used for any admission or replacement decision before round-trip turnover is recomputed.
Whether S4 v2 must be recomputed as a raw-alpha baseline or PD30 must be rerun with AR/M4 overlay for fair comparison.
Whether later PD33 5-spec evidence can repair the PD30 Forge package when the package itself and backtest_result_pd30 do not contain full 5-spec/baseline DSR parity.
Whether the user-nominated qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260511_001 path should exist; it is absent, and checks had to use stage_artifacts/WT_D20260511_001.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that PD30 raw C_softmax can be treated as a PIT-clean foundation decision point while its direct comparator is a documented overlay baseline, turnover is one-way only, lockbox decomposition is absent, and 5-spec/DSR parity is incomplete.
rebuttal_required: Recompute turnover with explicit one-way and round-trip fields and re-run Hurdle v2.2 using the 600% round-trip gate.
Produce same-period, same-cost, same-DSR S4 v2 baseline evidence or rerun PD30 with the same AR/M4 overlay layer.
Publish the required mailbox weights.csv and monthly_returns.parquet for PD30, or formally amend the artifact contract.
Run CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, and FF6 for each PD30 variant and the baseline.
Recompute DSR with a defensible total candidate count and apply the same penalty to candidate and baseline.
Add lockbox marker, frozen extension evidence, and Pre-LB/Lockbox/Combined metrics.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Forge supplies useful forensic evidence that Method B XV inflated PD28, but PD30 is not a clean AX-008 PASS source until baseline fairness, turnover, DSR, 5-spec, lockbox, and schedule artifacts are repaired.

forge_specific_questions: Pure Function v6.1 R12 hash audit이 PRE=POST 모두 일치하는가? Partial only: alpha/ETF hashes match, but risk/optimization package md5 evidence is missing.
walk-forward 시계열 충분 (≥60 sig_dates)이고 single-snapshot 위험 없는가? PD30 holdings are 298-date dynamic, but canonical weights.csv is absent and stage weights.csv is a stale 155-date static sleeve schedule.
Lockbox period strategy NAV가 equity_curve에 visible한가? Strategy line extends through 2026, but there is no lockbox marker or frozen-extension evidence, so RF-F3 remains flagged.
baseline 비교가 same-period · same-cost · same-DSR-penalty인가? No; it uses a documented S4 v2 overlay baseline and lacks same-period/same-DSR parity.
